why: This is a specific residential TFA teacher-training programme for novice teachers in a defined placement context, not a general reusable instructional pattern.
This describes the structure, requirements, learners, timing, and goals of one teacher-certification course rather than a reusable instructional element or a named product.

The supervised sequence of observing an experienced practitioner and then undertaking guided teaching practice is a setting-specific instance of Cognitive Apprenticeship, although its fixed TFA hours and tutor qualifications are local implementation details.
